# Redfern Plastering Solutions

> Brisbane-based plastering business specialising in high-quality plaster repairs, patching, renovations, and small to medium-sized residential and commercial projects. ABN 61 947 738 353. Phone 0425 743 992.

Redfern Plastering Solutions provides professional workmanship and friendly service from start to finish. Every job is completed to a high standard, on time and with minimal disruption.

## Services

- [Plaster repairs & patching](https://www.redfernplasteringsolutions.com.au/services/plaster-repairs): holes, cracks, cut-outs, nail pops, rental changeovers — gyprock, plasterboard and drywall all patched the same way. Cracks are taped, not just filled.
- [Ceiling repairs](https://www.redfernplasteringsolutions.com.au/services/ceiling-repairs): access cut-outs, sagging sheets, water stains, cornice, truss-uplift cracks.
- [Renovation plastering](https://www.redfernplasteringsolutions.com.au/services/renovation-plastering): full-room re-sheets, strip-outs, Level 4 and Level 5 finishes, square-set or cornice.
- [Water damage plaster repairs](https://www.redfernplasteringsolutions.com.au/services/water-damage-plaster-repairs): re-lining after storms and leaks, moisture-checked before re-boarding, insurance scopes.
- [New plasterboard installation](https://www.redfernplasteringsolutions.com.au/services/plasterboard-installation): extensions, garage conversions, room splits, wet-area board.
- [Commercial plastering](https://www.redfernplasteringsolutions.com.au/services/commercial-plastering): repairs, make-goods and fit-out linings, scheduled around operating hours.
- [Insurance plaster repairs](https://www.redfernplasteringsolutions.com.au/services/insurance-plaster-repairs): storm, leak, fire and impact damage — written scopes, photos, moisture documentation for assessors.
- [Sagging ceiling repairs](https://www.redfernplasteringsolutions.com.au/services/sagging-ceiling-repairs): ceilings re-bonded and re-screwed to battens, flat and staying flat — repair first, replace only when needed.

## Answers to common questions

- **How much does a plaster repair cost in Brisbane?** Every job is quoted in writing before work starts — small repairs are usually priced the same day from photos. Text photos for a firm written price.
- **Do you take on small jobs?** Yes — single patches and repairs are core work, not an inconvenience.
- **Why do cracks keep coming back?** Movement: truss uplift or frame settling. Repaired without tape, cracks reopen. Redfern tapes every crack so the repair flexes with the house.
- **Can you match a textured ceiling?** Smooth finishes disappear completely. Heavier stipple or orbital textures can usually be blended, but a perfect match on decades-old texture isn't always possible — stated honestly before starting.
- **Repair or replace a ceiling sheet?** Localised damage patches cleanly; a delaminated or sagging sheet is cheaper to replace than to fight.
- **Can a sagging ceiling be repaired instead of replaced?** Usually yes — the sheet is re-bonded with fresh adhesive and re-screwed to the battens at proper centres, then checked flat. Only delaminated, repeatedly-wet or structurally-damaged ceilings need replacement. See [sagging ceiling repairs](https://www.redfernplasteringsolutions.com.au/services/sagging-ceiling-repairs).
- **Can I claim plaster repairs on insurance?** Sudden and accidental damage (storms, burst pipes, impact) is usually covered; gradual wear usually isn't. Redfern provides written scopes, photos and moisture documentation that assessors accept. See [insurance plaster repairs](https://www.redfernplasteringsolutions.com.au/services/insurance-plaster-repairs).
- **Is pre-1990 fibro or hardboard a risk?** Yes — pre-1990 ceilings get asbestos-tested before any cutting. Redfern flags this on sight.
